info.name: Waai Media - Background Music API
info.description:
Comprehensive, fully testable Postman Collection for the Waai Media Background Music Module API (Laravel 13 backend).

### Overview:
The Background Music module manages public playback settings (`is_enabled`, `is_loop`, `audio_url`) and authenticated track uploads/replacements via Cloudflare R2 object storage.

### Endpoints:
- `GET /api/v1/background-music` (Public playback configuration, unauthenticated)
- `GET /api/v1/admin/background-music` (Admin & Editor track & toggle inspector)
- `PUT /api/v1/admin/background-music` (Admin & Editor toggle & track update/replacement)
- `POST /api/v1/admin/background-music` (Alternative method for multipart form-data uploads)

### Authorization Rules:
- Public GET is unauthenticated.
- Admin endpoints require `auth:sanctum`, `require.access`, and `role:admin,editor`.
- `admin` and `editor` roles are authorized.
- `viewer` and other unauthorized roles receive `403 Forbidden`.
- Requests missing a Bearer token or presenting an invalid/revoked token receive `401 Unauthorized`.

### Supported Audio Formats (Max 15 MiB):
- Supports all genuine audio formats (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, AAC, FLAC, OPUS, AIFF, WMA, etc.) detected via content inspection.
- Non-audio files disguised with an audio extension are strictly rejected with `422 Unprocessable Content`.
- Files exceeding 15 MiB (15,360 KB) are strictly rejected with `422 Unprocessable Content`.

### Postman Variables:
- `base_url`: Target host (default: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`).
- `admin_token`: Sanctum token with `role: admin` and `access` ability.
- `editor_token`: Sanctum token with `role: editor` and `access` ability.
- `token`: Shared active token (defaults to `{{admin_token}}`).
- `viewer_token`: Sanctum token with `role: viewer` (tests 403 Forbidden).
- `invalid_token`: Revoked or malformed token placeholder (tests 401 Unauthorized).

item.name: 4. Admin Audio Upload & Safe Replacement
4.1 Admin - Upload First Track (Valid MP3 - 200 OK)

formdata.description: Select a valid MP3 file (under 15 MiB). Supported MIME: audio/mpeg, audio/mp3.

request.description: Uploads an initial MP3 audio file to Cloudflare R2 storage, generates a UUID filename under music/audio/, and enables playback.

exec: pm.test('Track successfully stored and metadata returned', function () {
pm.test('R2 object URL stored as collection variable for replacement test', function () {

item.name: 4.2 Admin - Replace Audio Track (Valid WAV - 200 OK)

formdata.description: Select a valid WAV file (under 15 MiB). MIME: audio/wav, audio/x-wav.

request.description: Replaces the existing audio track with a WAV file. Safely supersedes previous track in R2 post-commit.

exec: pm.test('Track URL changed from previous track', function () {

item.name: 4.3 Admin - Replace Audio Track (Valid OGG - 200 OK)

formdata.description: Select a valid OGG audio file. MIME: audio/ogg, application/ogg.

request.description: Replaces current track with an OGG Vorbis audio file.

item.name: 4.4 Admin - Replace Audio Track (Valid M4A - 200 OK)

formdata.description: Select a valid M4A container audio file. MIME: audio/x-m4a, audio/mp4.

request.description: Replaces current track with an M4A audio file.

item.name: 4.5 Admin - Replace Audio Track (Valid AAC - 200 OK)

formdata.description: Select a valid AAC audio file (.aac). MIME: audio/aac, audio/x-hx-aac-adts.

request.description: Replaces current track with a standalone AAC audio file.

item.name: 4.6 Admin - Replace Audio Track (Valid FLAC - 200 OK)

formdata.description: Select a valid FLAC audio file (.flac). MIME: audio/flac.

request.description: Replaces current track with a FLAC lossless audio file.
